generated.what_happened: At New York Comic-Con, Marvel Television announced several upcoming releases and provided updates on its existing programming. The studio detailed its animation slate, revealing that Season 2 of "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man" will debut on January 13, 2027, followed by three "Marvel Zombies" Halloween specials starting in 2027 with "The Winter Soldier." For live-action productions, Marvel revealed "Zodiac," a spy thriller scheduled for a 2028 release that begins filming in London this spring. Additionally, updates were shared on other series, noting that "VisionQuest" will premiere on October 14, "Wonder Man" has been canceled, and "Daredevil: Born Again" will conclude with its third season next year.
